evidence.quote: The process parameter set for fabricating the samples was developed at a layer thickness of 30 μm. The samples were produced with an applied energy density of 121 J/mm3 and the scan strategy used was stripes with 67 ̊ rotation after each layer.
Samples were heat treated at 1000 ◦C in argon atmosphere for an hour for stress relief prior to being cut from the build plate made of pure tantalum using EDM
The microstructure is composed of single-phase BCC grains, and EBSD scans with higher resolutions did not reveal the presence of any non-equilibrium phases.
